Google Wallet

The tap-to-pay side of Google Wallet is not open to third-party apps. The only official integration is the Save to Google Wallet passes API, which needs a real issuer account. This app detects and opens Wallet when it is installed, and uses a clearly-labelled demo fallback otherwise.
Detect and open Google Wallet

Google Wallet is installed on this device. Opening it shows the real app; TapPay does not and cannot add cards to it. The demo fallback simulates what an officially-integrated pass flow would look like.
DEMO FALLBACK: on a device with an issuer-issued pass, TapPay would hand a demo pass to Google Wallet here. Nothing was added and no card data was touched.

TapPay Playground v1.0
Every card, payment, notification and Wallet flow in this app is a simulation. No real card details are ever read, stored or transmitted. The demo card number is a public test number and is not a real account.
Google Wallet: third-party apps are not allowed into its tap-to-pay stack, and real pass integration needs an issuer account, so this app only detects and opens Wallet when present and falls back to a demo otherwise.
Built with Java, XML and Material 3.
